script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Papa says he uses a group chat. Things outside his bakery should come up as things people do, not things he does.
Exodus 24:9 says Moses and the elders went up, not that they reached the top of the mountain.
The explanation repeats where each half of the blood goes without adding a distinctive or engaging Papa Dorin line.
The text says God did not lay His hand on the nobles. Saying nothing struck them goes beyond what it states.
The joke about handing the word protection a cookie has no clear connection to the action in the passage.
Moses says whoever has a dispute can go to Aaron and Hur. The explanation makes that permission sound mandatory.
Saying a dispute goes to Aaron and Hur makes the instruction sound automatic. Moses says whoever has a dispute can go to them.
